messages.subject: Energy & Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Alexander Jackson Executive Search Team,

Your executive-search work across energy, power and senior leadership aligns well with my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where strategic growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
